headline: Woonhuis Heenvliet  / Studio Brandvries
context: Woonhuis Heenvliet is located on the edge of the historic village of Heenvliet. When the owners bought the plot, it had an existing house that was partly built on the footprint of a barn that had once been part of a historic ensemble.
